title: Grateful Dead Live at Zoo Amphitheater on 1982-08-01

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality soundboard captures Jerry’s 40th birthday show where a hot first set gives way to a smoking second set – especially the Playin > Iko jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is a solid soundboard tape with clear mids and enough bass presence, though a few low‑level sections and heat‑induced distortion are noted. Musically the band struggled through an uneven first set, but the second set delivers highlights like Playin > Iko, Lost Sailor > Saint, and a tight Tennessee Jed, showing the group finding its groove despite the sweltering conditions.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 3‑5 stars and praise the second‑set flow, while a few note heat‑related slumps and recording quirks; the weighted average yields a solid but not stellar rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and well‑balanced soundboard tape, with occasional low‑level sections and mild heat‑related muddiness; bass notes are audible, no major dropouts reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set uneven and hampered by heat, but the second set flows seamlessly with continuous segues, especially the Playin‑Iko transition.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Start of show shows Jerry distressed by heat and wandering solos; later finds groove and delivers strong birthday jam on Iko and solid leads on Tennessee Jed.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is clear in the mix; no specific praise or criticism beyond general sound quality.
band_member_comments.Bob: Makes a zoo/animal joke before Iko, noted for his vocal presence on Tennessee Jed.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drumming highlighted as a strong point by one reviewer ('DON'T SKIP ON THE DRUMS').
